QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_1

question.text: Ms. Priya Shah, Fund Manager at Saraswati Capital AIF (Category II), is preparing the annual investor report for FY ending 31-Mar. By which date must the report be dispatched to investors under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations?

answer.text: Within 60 days of financial year-end (i.e., by 30-May)
Within 90 days of financial year-end (i.e., by 29-Jun)
Within 180 days of financial year-end (i.e., by 27-Sep)
Within 30 days of financial year-end (i.e., by 30-Apr)

explanation.text: The Logic: Non-Category III AIFs are required to report to their investors at least annually, within 180 days from the end of the financial year. For a 31-Mar year-end, 180 days lands on 27-Sep, so a Category II fund such as Saraswati Capital must dispatch the annual report by that date. The Trap: The 60-day window is the Category III quarterly-reporting deadline. 90 days mirrors typical audit timelines but is not the SEBI AIF investor-reporting rule. 30 days does not correspond to the investor-report deadline. Note: Category III AIFs report to investors on a quarterly basis within 60 days of quarter-end, which is a separate and more frequent obligation.
